_comments: BILL.COM JOBS (golive #146/#148, design §6). Both SHIP DISABLED AND SET TO PREVIEW, for the same two
reasons as the renewal job: Disabled keeps a lower environment from scheduling live invoicing the moment
this metadata lands; Preview means even an enabled job writes nothing until a person has read one run.
Going live is two named acts per job: enable, read the run's Results/Outcomes with Finance, then set
Preview to false. Only the second act sends a customer an invoice or records cash.
SEND: every 30 minutes, 13:00–23:59 UTC, weekdays (7am–6pm Central). A confirmed order should reach
Bill.com the same half-hour; MaxCount 25 means a mis-configuration invoices 25 customers, not the book.
POLL: hourly at :15, every day — ACH clears in days, hourly is generous, and :15 never coincides with
the send. MaxCount 100; a capped pass keeps its watermark so the remainder is read next pass.
Both: ConcurrencyMode Skip (two passes racing would each read 'unsent'), MissedRunPolicy RunOnce (a week
of missed runs is one catch-up), RunImmediatelyIfNeverRun false (nobody is billed before a person looks).
OwnerUserID / NotifyUserID deliberately unset: they name people, which differs per environment.

fields.Name: Orders — Send External Invoices (half-hourly, business hours)
fields.Description: Creates Bill.com invoices for billing units that have become invoiceable: confirmed orders billed as a whole and issued instalments. Ships disabled and set to Preview: enable it, confirm the Results list on the run, then set Preview to false to begin sending.

fields.Name: Orders — Poll External Payments (hourly)
fields.Description: Reads cleared customer payments from Bill.com and records each once against the orders its invoices belong to. Ships disabled and set to Preview: enable it, confirm the Outcomes list on the run, then set Preview to false to begin recording cash.
